verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a graphics card. It does not hold a user's account data, so exporting all of one's data in open formats and leaving is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows NVIDIA offering a data-export or account-portability feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
